messages:
jordan: Heads-up — dry-run for promo to eu-west failed on billing chart. Helm template error from overlays/edgezone. Anyone on call?

emma: hitting it now. paste the error?

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: DRY-RUN FAILED
service billing: helm template failed: overlay merge error at path payments.timeout
Command: helm upgrade --install billing ./charts/billing --dry-run --values values/eu.yaml --values overlays/edgezone.yaml
Error: overlay 'edgezone' has conflicting type for key 'payments.timeout' (string vs integer)
Logs: http://ci.internal/DRY-5678

jordan: Overlay uses '30s' (string) while base expects 30 (int). Last merge automated by bot may have introduced the string.

li: I'd prefer a schema migration, but short-term pin to billing@2.3.1 and promote. Then schedule a hotpatch to normalize the type and add a Helm values schema.

emma: Agreed. Pin is safest for tonight's window. Who can push the pin?

li: I can. Will open a small PR to change chartVersion in overlays/edgezone/kustomization.yaml and add a note.

jordan: Also let's hold the promotable window until canary runs for 20m. Last incident we saw a spike when probes were marginal.

ops-bot: k8s: recent canary for a different service had readiness flapping. Recommend 3 replicas for canary.

li: PR commands I run:
```
# pin chart version in overlay
git checkout -b fix/edgezone-billing-pin
yq e '.resources[0].chartVersion = "2.3.1"' -i overlays/edgezone/kustomization.yaml
git add overlays/edgezone/kustomization.yaml && git commit -m "pin billing chart to 2.3.1 to avoid values type drift" && git push origin fix/edgezone-billing-pin
```
I'll request review from @emma.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: PR merged, starting canary billing@2.3.1 at 5% traffic. Canary id CANY-442.

ops-bot: k8s: canary started. billing-eu-canary pods x3 (requests: 100m). Ready 3/3.

emma: Nice. Drafting release note entry: - temporarily pinned billing chart to 2.3.1 due to values type mismatch in edgezone overlay; follow-up hotpatch to normalize payments.timeout to int and add values schema.

jordan: Rollback snippet for notes:
```
# rollback
helm rollback billing $(helm history billing -n prod | sed -n '2p' | awk '{print $1}') -n prod
kubectl -n prod rollout status deployment/billing
```
Also ping infra-oncall if rollback.

ops-bot: canary metrics @10m: errors +0.0%, p50 latency +3%, readiness 100%. No alerts.

li: Bumping to 25% now. deploy-bot: route-canary CANY-442 set-traffic 25%

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: traffic updated to 25% for CANY-442.

emma: monitoring looks fine at 25%. If stable for 20m, promote.

ops-bot: canary 25% at 18m: latency +1%, errors unchanged.

jordan: No objections. Promote to 100% after short wait.

li: promoting now. deploy-bot: promote CANY-442

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: promoted canary CANY-442 — billing@2.3.1 deployed to prod. Notifying release-notes-bot.

release-notes-bot: release-notes-bot: Added entry 2024-11-24: 'Pinned billing chart to 2.3.1 to avoid values type coercion in edgezone overlay; hotpatch scheduled to normalize schema.'

ops-bot: prod rollout complete. pods ready 9/9. No incidents.

emma: Thanks li. After the hotpatch, let's add a CI check to validate types in overlays (yq + type-check).

jordan: Agreed — let's spin a short ticket and assign to infra-q2.

li: Closing this thread once release notes link posted.

release-notes-bot: release-notes-bot: https://releases.internal/notes/2024-11-24/billing-pin
